name: Duskframe AR Wrap Visor — Civic Series
description: A wrap-around visor with a continuous curved lens spanning temple to temple, manufactured by Duskframe for the Tier 3 professional market. The frame is brushed bronze-tone recycled aluminum, thin enough to read as fashion but sturdy enough for daily transit wear. The lens shifts from clear to 80% tint via electrochromic film. Integrated AR overlays — transit data, personal notifications, navigation — project at the lens periphery. A discreet neural-port sync tab sits at the right temple, flush with the frame.
functionality: AR overlay displays transit schedules, calendar prompts, and navigation. Electrochromic tint adjusts automatically to ambient light. Neural-port sync enables hands-free menu navigation. Bluetooth-equivalent mesh networking for device pairing.
what_it_says: You're connected, organized, and you bought something that looks intentional rather than institutional.
manufacturer: Duskframe (mid-market corponation, eyewear and AR optics)
story_hooks: The Civic Series AR overlay has a known firmware vulnerability — a skilled hacker can push false navigation data and reroute the wearer without them realizing it.
A batch sold through gray-market retailers has an undocumented passive data-harvesting mode that logs location and biometric stress markers back to an unknown endpoint.
A Tier 3 wearer discovered their visor's AR layer was overlaying corporate ad content over a protest gathering, replacing the crowd with an empty plaza.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Resuscitation Frame — 'The Pallbearer's Daughter'

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist wrap-around visor that frames the upper face with a continuous curved lens. The design reads as both protective and aspirational—corporate-approved but street-aware. The continuous arc creates an almost insectoid silhouette, softened by the warm bronze tone of the frame.
physical_description.fit: Snug but not compression; sits flush against the brow and temples with minimal weight distribution. Designed for 8+ hour daily wear without pressure points. The curve follows the natural contour of the skull.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed bronze-tone recycled aluminum frame; electrochromic smart-film lens (transitions clear to 80% tint on demand)
physical_description.texture: Frame is brushed matte—non-reflective, warm to the touch, slightly textured to prevent slipping. Lens is smooth glass-like polymer, cool and frictionless. Neural sync tab has a subtle grip texture.
physical_description.color_scheme: Muted bronze-gold frame with clear-to-dark gray lens gradient. Minimal branding—Duskframe logo laser-etched at the right temple in matte silver.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit temple arms with micro-adjustable tension; no visible clasps or snaps. Seamless integration.
distinctive_features: Continuous curved lens spanning temple-to-temple (no bridge break)
Discreet neural-port sync tab at right temple—flush-mounted, barely visible
Integrated AR projection (peripheral display layer, invisible when inactive)
Anti-glare coating with faint holographic shimmer under direct light
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 professional—expensive enough to signal stability and access, cheap enough to be replaceable. Not street-luxury, but clearly above salvage.
physical_description.cultural_context: Transit worker, mid-tier corpo, logistics coordinator, medical technician. Wearing this says: 'I have access to networked tools and steady employment.' Also appeals to privacy-conscious commuters and those who need AR without looking militant.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn. Occasional smudges on lens; frame shows minimal scratches. If patched, it would signal financial strain—most Tier 3 users replace rather than repair.
